title: Port the door/container auth-challenge and cold-start-budget parity checks from ticks
description:
Filed from a worker finding on ticks tick 3r2 attempt 6, during the factory deletion. The factory moved to ticfac, but two parity checks that guarded it stayed behind in ticks and would be deleted with the rest: the door/container auth-challenge check and the cold-start-budget check. They are the tests that prove the deployed factory still behaves, so they belong here now.

Read ticks' epic/pwp branch for what they were before the deletion.
